goals.objective: Automated worker execution and independent QC
success_conditions: All worker planner, scope, attempts and orchestration tests execute in CI on the exact integrated main commit.
Each job is traceable from objective to claim, attempts, failures, checks and integration evidence.
not_a_success: Claiming a closed chat proves integrated implementation.

goals.objective: Point-in-time source-verified USD market and issuer evidence
success_conditions: SFTBY, CRWV and AAOI have reproducible 200+ completed-session history where available.
Historical USD/JPY inputs and dependency TTD fail closed when stale.
Issuer-event corrections replay by availability and ingestion times.
not_a_success: Inventing missing current market data or live services.
Treating funding tranches as additional commitments.

goals.objective: Defensible ownership, capital and revenue-pool accounting
success_conditions: Fund, parent and direct exposures reconcile without double counting.
Customer-facing demand and upstream intermediary spending are separated.
SFTBY holdings and NAV scenarios disclose dated USD, FX and coverage limitations.
not_a_success: Adding OEM sales and intermediary resale as independent final demand.
Confusing investment cost, debt or synthetic marks with equity NAV.

goals.objective: Reproducible narrative and traversal intelligence for three holdings
success_conditions: Narrative claims include alternatives, falsifiers and point-in-time sources.
Traversal reports 5/20/60/200-window position, direction and price-volume velocity.
Cycle scenarios include transaction costs and missed rebounds.
not_a_success: Presenting stale dependent calculations as current.

milestones.objective: Integrate B05, B00 and initial B01 strict gates
exit_criteria: Three reviewed PRs merged; strict integrated main workflow passed at a recorded exact SHA.

milestones.objective: Execute full worker QC on a real independent runner
exit_criteria: Exact-commit CI runs planner, scope, attempts, protocol and adversarial tests with fail-closed results.
Integration checks on main include all required gates and do not pass by missing-script skip.

milestones.objective: Validate market and event point-in-time replay
exit_criteria: B02 and B03 own domain tests execute against source-identified revisions with no lookahead.
Historical input coverage and provider/FX gaps are explicitly quantified or marked unknown.

milestones.objective: Revenue-pool mapping and SoftBank exposure reconciliation
exit_criteria: B19 maps upstream/customer gateway revenue without double counting.
B05 OpenAI reconciliation and B09 holdings use dated source, currency, FX and uncertainty.
Narrative and traversal results reproduce from exact inputs and versions.
No unsupported probabilities or stale data declared current.

milestones.objective: Verify evidence-gated planner execution and canonical coverage audit dispatch
exit_criteria: T-014 local allowlisted checks and fail-closed decision tests independently pass on exact PR head.
T-012 publishes dated canonical coverage inventory with owner-tagged gaps; no branch-only claims promoted to main.
B21 stores S1-S8 and NVDA-H01-H06 as dated unverified hypotheses with falsifiers and explicit graph/event dependencies.

execution_policy.dispatch: Select highest-impact unblocked goal and dispatch reuse-capabilities inside owner scope; active session count is not inferred from PR status.
execution_policy.failure: Failed QC records exact attempt evidence then requeues the same task to the same owner with bounded retries and explicit correction.
execution_policy.integration: Promote only exact-commit tested changes; verify every mandatory check and main CI before downstream milestones unlock.
execution_policy.source_truth: GitHub issue, PR, changed file and CI states are authoritative; goals and queue define desired work, not live completion.
